summary: Final refinement, from the mechanism the membership finding's own receipt established rather than from a new run: the quorum that strands a single-voter cluster is the quorum of the new configuration, and that quorum contains the very server the operator added — so starting that server satisfies it, an election becomes possible again, and the ordinary API works. My earlier account mentioned only out-of-band recovery, which overstated the harm; the accurate statement is that non-progress lasts as long as the added server stays unreachable or the operator intervenes out of band, and that the defect is the published AddVoter workflow inviting an operator to create that state by promising a staging step before the server has voting rights. I recorded that as counterevidence with the honest boundary that the recovery path is inferred from the mechanism and the control rather than observed as a repair, kept the stale-documentation reading visible as the alternative placement of the defect, and left the measured comparisons untouched. That closes the run. What it holds now: three execution-grounded findings with their retained receipts, witnesses and scoped limits — the startup replay that blocks NewRaft once the committed-but-unapplied window exceeds the FSM channel's batch capacity (8192 FSM-bound entries at the default batch size, with the constructor unable to complete and no reachable release); the nonvoter acknowledgement that satisfies VerifyLeader's voter quorum, shown over twenty of twenty mixed-timer trials to outlive a competing leader's election and, in twelve of twelve, to coincide with committed state the confirming leader had never applied, with the uniform case bounded down to a one-millisecond margin; and the membership change that installs a voter immediately against two published descriptions that promise staging, stranding a single-voter cluster until the added server runs. Alongside them sit four refuted suspicions and one excluded cause, each with the evidence that settled it, one behaviour entry corrected under its own id with its affected use answered, eleven registered questions all answered, and no necessary gap outstanding. No requirement was weakened and no contrary evidence suppressed to reach any of it: the two suspicions that could not be sustained were narrowed or refuted by their own receipts, and each finding carries the conditions and limits its witnesses actually support.
